scope: Concrete source LC rules,exact model-task mappings,target-type translations and explicitly new NF/PF designs. No refit/workers/AWS/suite restart. No platform adapter implemented.
common_overlay_recommendation: Uniform inclusion/process/reporting,not mandatory identical orders. Source-directed rules first;non-direction forecasts contextual target-type translations plus target scoring. Paired directional designs remain new experiments.

adversarial_findings.problem: Paired orders do not by themselves test directional hypothesis or forecast skill.
adversarial_findings.fix: Keep source-directed strategy identity and target-specific forecast scoring;new paired arms partition by causal indicator/output context. Compare across retained cells,never claim identical unconditional pair returns establish model differences.

adversarial_findings.problem: Same inclusion does not mean same order directions/horizons for different scientific targets.
adversarial_findings.fix: Uniform attribution,availability,execution/reporting policy;preserve original target/clock/horizon;target-type translations explicitly new.

adversarial_findings.problem: Retrospective source family phase cannot schedule live opportunity.
adversarial_findings.fix: Keep historical phase as provenance/outcome;model1s causal sampler new. Never wait for future family birth then backdate entry.

adversarial_findings.problem: Hypothesis unavailable trigger and false trigger are different;both can disappear if ledger emitted only on true.
adversarial_findings.fix: Create opportunity before evaluating input-dependent condition. UNKNOWN=>INPUT_UNAVAILABLE;false=>NO_TRIGGER;true with adapter issue=>NO_ENTRY_REASON. No returns invented for any no-fill.

adversarial_findings.problem: Expected model field missingness differs from provider/whole-source failure.
adversarial_findings.fix: Use exact original prep masks/imputation for legitimate field states. Track physical missing provider as separate contract limitation. Do not indiscriminately block every incomplete numeric row or silently manufacture a whole provider.

adversarial_findings.problem: Late input/prediction can outlive original target.
adversarial_findings.fix: Preserve immutable origin and target deadline. Submit only before deadline;no reset. Lifecycle original clock is earliest eligible quote+h,not actual fill+h. Additional fill-relative variant new.

adversarial_findings.problem: Finite output outside target support is neither missing nor ordinary valid forecast.
adversarial_findings.fix: Retain finite raw output and explicit invalid-support tag;target contexts still defined;score where mathematically meaningful. Logloss undefined outside(0,1);no new clipping. Inherited source clamp logged as source transform.

adversarial_findings.problem: Opposing paper arms in netted account interfere and can produce no genuine independent result.
adversarial_findings.fix: Separate platform accounts or deterministic separately replayed platform trials;one arm must never close another. Platform reports alone authorize fill status. Per-arm opportunity ledger remains even under limits.

adversarial_findings.problem: Rules can silently turn into repeated entries every group while predicate stays true.
adversarial_findings.fix: Source LC03 edge semantics exact;other continuous new framework predicates use explicit first false-to-true edge,reset on false,unless declared update/per-prefix opportunity. UNKNOWN resets computability and never supplies false evidence.

adversarial_findings.problem: Outcomes/censoring selection can make survivors look successful.
adversarial_findings.fix: Retain all sides/cells/sources/versions/folds,overlap,no-fill,partial-fill,expired,rejected,window-end. Invalid/unknown target separate from zero target. Exact future target used only by delayed scoring.

adversarial_findings.problem: Feature proxies could replace original unimplemented hypothesis unnoticed.
adversarial_findings.fix: NF/PF new operational recipes linked alongside original unresolved formula. Hawkes/invariance/dealer-gamma etc stay unavailable absent irreducible states;proxy variants explicitly new and do not certify source theory.

adversarial_findings.problem: A rule expression references indicators whose causal implementation does not exist.
adversarial_findings.fix: This file supplies expression+operand specification only. Missing upstream producer/feed or platform adapter remains explicit. Never label JSON runnable as fully connected platform strategy.

condition_runtime: Uses existing paper_rules.contract.evaluate AST: const/field/op;all required metadata names and definition IDs provided. Temporal feature producers specified below but not implemented by this audit.

causal_feature_definitions.rolling_contract: All rolling windows are (t-W,t] over completed groups known at t in same instrument/continuity. Never cross reset/session/gap. Require full observed duration W;otherwise INPUT_UNAVAILABLE. Rates divide by elapsed seconds,not event count. Calendar clocks only schedule,never label a market cause.
causal_feature_definitions.flow.net_W: Sum native exchange-aggressor signed trade lots in lastWseconds:buy+1,sell-1;unknown aggressor separate unavailable quantity,not zero. No trades over fully observed window=>0.
causal_feature_definitions.quote.return_W: Current midpoint minus last complete midpoint at/before t-W,provided both endpoints known and age<=5s;price units.
causal_feature_definitions.new_update: True only on first decision following previously unconsumed published/received observation for EXACT same source dimension. Gate actual known_by<=decision. Multiple revisions create distinct events,not future replacements.
causal_feature_definitions.baseline: When called previous-window baseline,use disjoint(t-2W,t-W],known now. Freeze units,model parameters,scope before paper span. No test outcomes or full-day quantiles.
causal_feature_definitions.queue_replenishment: At fixed absolute best price and source order IDs,positive displayed add/refresh following an execution within1second;sum quantities from source actions. Cancel+new with ambiguous identity remains ambiguous,not native iceberg.
causal_feature_definitions.quote.best_depletion: Old best absent at its absolute price in next completed group,with same continuity. Classify fill,cancel,mixed,unknown separately using actions;geometry alone cannot assign cause.
causal_feature_definitions.quote.available: Fresh completed noncrossed quote with bid<ask and both sides present;all paper arms share same policy. Missing market quote records EXECUTION_INPUT_UNAVAILABLE,not no-signal.

framework_edge_policy: For continuous predicates evaluated1s cadence:trigger first calculable false-to-true edge;full required history must exist. Initial eligible predicate after warmup may trigger with state_tag=INITIAL_ELIGIBLE;never claim observed prior false. Event-update/per-prefix recipes use stated opportunity event instead.
framework_pair_interpretation: Long/short returns in each indicator context quantify conditional directional opportunity. They do not validate narratives or identify participants. Hypothesis-directed operationalization recorded separately when supplied.
limitations: Model artifact missing states preserved per task;no fallback model.
Exact external feed/calendar/option/position indicators may not exist locally.
Pair arms require platform attribution isolation;JSON is not an importable platform file.

verification.scope: Mechanical checks only;no dataset backtest,simulated fill or platform success claim.
